description: A web game created for Js13kGames

scripts.test:packets: npm run build && node scripts/test.mjs packets
scripts.build:client: npm run typecheck && npm run catalog:go && vite build
scripts.test:go: npm run catalog:go && tsx scripts/generate-go-wire-fixtures.ts && tsx scripts/generate-go-broad-phase-fixtures.ts && tsx scripts/generate-go-physics-world-fixtures.ts && tsx scripts/generate-go-rotation-fixtures.ts && tsx scripts/generate-go-region-fixtures.ts && tsx scripts/generate-go-asteroid-fixtures.ts && tsx scripts/generate-go-movement-fixtures.ts && tsx scripts/generate-go-item-fixtures.ts && tsx scripts/generate-go-http-fixtures.ts && tsx scripts/generate-go-gameplay-fixtures.ts && GOEXPERIMENT=simd go test ./cmd/... ./internal/... ./tests/go-fixtures/snapshot && tsx tests/go-snapshot.test.ts && tsx tests/go-session.test.ts
scripts.build:go: npm run build:client && mkdir -p bin && GOEXPERIMENT=simd go build -o bin/go-server ./cmd/go-server
scripts.dev:go-server: npm run build:client && npm run start:go-server
scripts.test:go:physics: npm run catalog:go && tsx scripts/generate-go-broad-phase-fixtures.ts && tsx scripts/generate-go-physics-world-fixtures.ts && tsx scripts/generate-go-rotation-fixtures.ts && go test ./internal/collision/... ./internal/physics/...
